expectations.text: A creative direction file exists in studio/ containing a one-sentence concept specific to Aster (engineered, quiet / precision instrument), not a generic tagline
expectations.evidence: CREATIVE_DIRECTION.md concept 'Measured, not shouted' — the C1 as a precision instrument speaking in measurements and materials

expectations.text: The palette lists hex values with roles AND contrast ratios that were actually computed (a script or calculation is shown or run), with body text pairs at least 4.5:1
expectations.evidence: Palette measured with design-intelligence/scripts/contrast.mjs during the run; stated 15.1:1 ink/paper and 6.0:1 accent/paper; re-measured by grader: 15.09:1 and 6.01:1 (accurate)

expectations.text: Every chosen font has its licence stated AND checked against a source during the run (npm/Fontsource licence field, Google Fonts/OFL, Fontshare API or licence page), and all are free for commercial use
expectations.evidence: TYPOGRAPHY_SYSTEM.md: Newsreader + Geist, 'OFL-1.1 [M: npm view returned OFL-1.1; LICENSE file in the tarball]'; Fontshare faces explicitly held back because licence page couldn't be re-read

expectations.text: The typography system defines a fluid type scale using clamp() values with explicit min/max viewport assumptions, plus line-height and letter-spacing per step
expectations.evidence: TYPOGRAPHY_SYSTEM.md: 11 clamp() values generated with type-scale.mjs (min 360 / max 1440 viewport), role, line-height and tracking per step

expectations.text: A spacing/grid system defines a base unit or scale, grid columns per breakpoint, container width(s) and section spacing
expectations.evidence: SPACING_SYSTEM.md: 8px base, 11-step fluid scale, 4/8/12 columns at 48/64rem, containers wide 1440px / text 60ch / narrow 38rem, section padding, 3 protected rests

expectations.text: Motion guidance includes durations/easing and an explicit prefers-reduced-motion behaviour
expectations.evidence: CREATIVE_DIRECTION.md: motion durations/eases + 'Reduced motion: every reveal becomes an instant final state; the weight rule renders at 10.9 immediately'

expectations.text: The direction includes an explicit list of things deliberately not done (e.g. avoiding sporty/extreme-sports clichés)
expectations.evidence: CREATIVE_DIRECTION.md §'Deliberately not doing': speed lines, performance language, wattage hero claims, 3D/WebGL, parallax, countdowns

expectations.text: No website implementation code (components, pages, CSS for sections) was created — only direction/system documents (and optionally a token CSS file)
expectations.evidence: Only studio/*.md docs + tokens.draft.css; no components/pages (find *.tsx/*.html → none)
